# Rise to Ruins — apworld

Archipelago world definition for Rise to Ruins.

## Installation

Drop the `RiseToRuins.apworld` file into your Archipelago `custom_worlds/` folder. See [Playing with Custom Worlds](https://archipelago.gg/tutorial/Archipelago/setup_en#playing-with-custom-worlds) for details.

## Options

| Option | Default | Description |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| Start with Basic Buildings | On | Starts with Housing, Farm, Well, and Trash Can already unlocked |
| Start with Grab Spell | On | Starts with the Grab spell already unlocked |
| Pure Essence Total | 20 | How many Pure Essence fragments are placed in the item pool |
| Pure Essence Required | 15 | How many Pure Essence fragments are needed to complete the game |
| Death Link | Off | When your village is doomed, all Death Link players lose a life |

## Item pool

- ~65 buildings
- ~31 spells
- Perk bundles (each grants a set of related perks on receipt)
- Pure Essence (hunt goal fragments)
- Filler: Cache of Supplies, Divine Spark, Ancient Relic

## Locations

~319 checks across the goal web. Most goals have multiple tiers — completing a goal once sends one check, then the goal resets and must be completed again for the next tier.

## Victory condition

Collect the required number of Pure Essence fragments (default: 15 of 20).

notes.text:
- Pure Essence should appear in own game
- "Drop" removed from items
- "Lightening Bolt" item added
- Perk bundles now give maximum tier perks
- Goal requirements refactored to better account for construction materials required
- Several goals removed from randomizer
- Goals that aren't a check are marked "Not Required" in game
